name: Ani Tama!
source:
A young boy fended off his abusive sister, who took all of his valuables and his power. One day in the safety of playing with a female childhood friend, he received a confession. And to the sister who he thought hated him, another confession... and his answer is...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ062456.html]DLsite English[/url]]

一个小男孩击退了虐待他的妹妹，妹妹夺走了他所有的贵重物品和权力。有一天，在安全地与一位儿时女性朋友玩耍时，他收到了一份坦白。而对他以为恨他的妹妹，又一次坦白……而他的回答是……
